source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Collect detailed information of the incident:
i. Time and date of the accident.
ii. Exact location within the workplace.
iii. Names, job roles, and contact details of involved employees, witnesses, supervisors, and any other relevant parties.
iv. Description of the accident including what happened, how it happened, and any immediate contributing factors (e.g., equipment failure, slip/trip/fall, lack of training).

3. Gather witness statements:
i. Interview witnesses as soon as possible while the event is fresh in their memory.
ii. Record their accounts on company forms or take detailed notes.
iii. Follow up and record any additional insights that may come to light later.

4. Secure the scene and equipment:
i. Prevent further damage or accidents by securing the area promptly.
ii. Do not disturb the accident scene until the investigation has been completed unless doing so would threaten the safety of others.
iii. Take photographs or video footage of the accident scene
